name: Install and launch Zain
entry_point: Installer double-click (unsigned NSIS; SmartScreen 'More info, Run anyway' documented)
failure_recovery: Install failure leaves no partial registration; rerun is idempotent; uninstall cleans (Z-22)

name: Create or open a project
entry_point: Home: Open folder / Clone / New project
failure_recovery: Unreadable or non-git folder gives a clear state; git init offered, never automatic

name: Configure a local or authorized remote model
entry_point: Settings: Models: Add endpoint, or first-run onboarding
failure_recovery: Probe failure shows which capability failed; route stays disabled; secrets go to keyring

name: Start an AI coding conversation
failure_recovery: Provider auth expired: re-login through the provider CLI; turn marked failed, not lost

name: Request a multi-file code modification
failure_recovery: Provider error mid-turn: checkpoint before turn allows revert; partial edits visible in diff

name: Review and accept or reject changes
entry_point: Diff panel after a turn; per-file and per-hunk accept/reject; open in external editor
failure_recovery: Rejected hunks restored from checkpoint; external edits refresh the diff

name: Create a detailed implementation plan
failure_recovery: R0: plan mode labelled 'not yet enforced'; from R2 out-of-plan writes invalidate the plan

name: Run an autonomous engineering task
failure_recovery: Mission survives reboot; failed step retried within budget, then waits for a human

name: Inspect agent progress and tool actions
entry_point: Thread activity timeline; later Inbox and trust indicator
failure_recovery: Unknown outcomes listed explicitly instead of hidden

name: Approve sensitive operations
failure_recovery: Denied or expired approval stops the effect; agent told; no silent retry

name: Run and diagnose tests
entry_point: Terminal or agent runs tests; later E2E lane and debugger
failure_recovery: R0: runner crash keeps output and the user can stop the turn; R2: budgets stop loops

name: Create and inspect Git changes
entry_point: Source control view; commit; branch; PR
failure_recovery: Destructive git operations require approval from R1 (C-12 seam S7)

name: Resume an interrupted agent task
failure_recovery: R0: in-flight turn marked interrupted and can be re-sent; R2: resume with a context capsule (M-05)

name: Recover from a failed operation
failure_recovery: APPLIED / NOT_APPLIED / UNKNOWN shown with evidence; retry only when replay-safe

name: Manage multiple projects
failure_recovery: Missing project folder: project marked unavailable, not deleted

name: Change agent or model configuration
failure_recovery: Switching mid-thread starts a new provider session; history kept

name: Control background execution
failure_recovery: Missed runs follow the missed-run policy; user can cancel any background task

name: Restore a previous checkpoint
failure_recovery: Untracked files quarantined, not deleted (Z-27)

name: Investigate a security event
entry_point: Inbox or ledger view: event detail: export
failure_recovery: Ledger gap (unanchored interval) shown explicitly

name: Export a complete engineering execution report
failure_recovery: Redaction failure blocks export rather than leaking

name: Use the integrated terminal
entry_point: Terminal panel: new terminal (PowerShell, Git Bash, wsl.exe as a shell)
failure_recovery: Hung process: kill from the panel; from R1 ProcessHost kills the whole job tree (WSL excluded)

name: Search and navigate project files
entry_point: File explorer; project search; open file from results
failure_recovery: Search on a huge repository is cancellable; ignored files excluded
